anchor_evidence.claim: R-07 is a new conscious life: Gu Heng's memories provide continuity and dispositions, while post-startup circumstances, interpretation and choices form R-07's own consciousness and values.
Gu Heng died; Gu Heng's doctor wife did not die and remains alive.
Gu Heng did not love Shen Yu. Shen Yu's old one-sided feeling and R-07's newly formed feeling have different sources; R-07 cannot inherit a love that Gu Heng never had.
Present R-07 has no sight, hearing, body, movement or self-sensation; external input appears only as text in consciousness, and past sensory memories never become present perception.
Before R-07 activation, Gu Heng's mission line and Shen Yu's assignment line briefly proceed in parallel and merge at activation; after activation they do not remain two present-time lines.
anchor_evidence.approved_floor: The approved chain confirms only that the opening may use Gu Heng and Shen Yu viewpoints and that after activation there is one present line.
anchor_evidence.derived_extension: The full two-preline-and-merge architecture is not explicitly author-locked by I0-I5/V1/V2.

evidence.locator: 默认叙述顺序 and time ledger

anchor_evidence.claim: After R-07 activates, there is one present-tense line; dialogue-triggered Gu Heng memory fragments are subjective, interruptible past material, not an independent storyline.

The command chain authorizes the immature memory-digital-life attempt. Shen Yu is recommended because her research fits and voluntarily accepts the assignment after learning it at the secret base; she does not choose whether the project starts.

R-07 supplies fragmented leads, not a one-line solution. Hostage rescue, expert testimony, hardware seizure, authorization verification and team action must corroborate and operationalize the intelligence.
R-07's initial collapse is caused by learning its sensory, bodily, agency and exit limitations. Shen Yu's pressure may worsen or prolong withdrawal but does not cause that collapse.
R-07 may delay causal details to protect Zhou Lan and private relations only while no innocent is endangered; the no-harm rule overrides family protection.
R-07 cannot self-terminate, copy itself or create a backup. Shen Yu performs the authorized shutdown, which irreversibly ends the current continuous consciousness and its post-startup experience.
The meteorological attack is fully prevented, but preventing it does not restore interstate trust or resolve the full causal interest chain.

Future loading may remain technically possible, but whether the promise is realizable, whether it is compassionate concealment, and whether a future loaded being would still be R-07 remain unresolved.

The narrative may show observable facts, perceivable states and processual mental activity, but never decisive mental activity that directly discloses R-07's terminal choice before farewell and shutdown.

anchor_evidence.claim: Before farewell, Shen Yu regards reducing R-07's suffering as her foremost immediate responsibility and acts while retaining guilt and uncertainty.
At the end of the first volume, the current R-07 consciousness has ended and no active R-07 copy survives.
